text_block_list.text:
Голд Шип's chillax strategy proves
effective, and
she delivers a
performance for the ages! But what
will
stoke her competitive fire now?!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Just as Голд Шипп prepares to start a life
working
the land, Эйсин Флэш challenges
her to a battle in
the upcoming Arima
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What's more, she'll throw in a new clue
from the
Book of Secrets if Голд Шип
accepts the
challenge! It's a deal that
can't be beat, and just
like that, Gold
Ship is back in action!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
